confidence: Rice alone, from Qian Yong's Lower Yangzi in normal years of the mid-Qianlong. After 1785 rice and the cash rate both rose (rice 1.9-2.7 taels a shi at 1,300-1,400 cash a tael), so a later amount reads high.

cash.note: About 800 cash to the tael (Jiangnan, 760-840 in the mid-Qianlong; 1,300-1,400 by 1796)

rice.label: historical
rice.note: 14-15 cash a sheng at 760-840 cash a tael: 1.7-2.0 taels a shi

wage.note: Lower Yangzi, 0.071 tael a day (Liu); Allen et al.'s are about 30% higher
